obligation: Annual Report to MSRB (audited FS + occupancy + DSCR)
due_rule_text_verbatim: not later than one hundred eighty (180) days after the end of each Fiscal Year, commencing with the Fiscal Year ending December 31, 2025

obligation: Audited financial statements filed when available if not in Annual Report
due_rule_text_verbatim: the audited financial statements shall be filed when they become available

obligation: Notice of failure to file Annual Report
due_rule_text_verbatim: If the Borrower is unable to provide the Annual Report by the date required in Section 4(a), the Borrower shall ... send a notice to the MSRB
in a timely manner not in excess of ten (10) Business Days after the occurrence of the event

obligation: Notice of change in Fiscal Year
due_rule_text_verbatim: the Borrower shall give notice of such change in the same manner as for a Listed Event

obligation: Quarterly rent roll and occupancy report
due_rule_text_verbatim: Within forty-five (45) days after the end of each calendar quarter
Within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each Fiscal Year
On or before each anniversary of the Closing Date
within one hundred eighty (180) days after the end of such Fiscal Year

obligation: Debt Service Coverage Ratio calculation delivered with audited FS
due_rule_text_verbatim: The Borrower shall deliver the calculation of such ratio to the Trustee together with such audited financial statements
such other information regarding the Project as the Trustee may reasonably request from time to time
promptly notify ... of any litigation ... that ... could reasonably be expected to have a material adverse effect
On or before January 31 of each year
within sixty (60) days after the applicable Computation Date; Computation Date means each fifth anniversary of the Closing Date and the date of final payment
for the term of the Bonds plus three (3) years after the final payment of the Bonds

obligation: Notice prior to change in use
due_rule_text_verbatim: shall notify the Issuer and Bond Counsel prior to any change in use of the Project
Within fifteen (15) days after the end of each calendar quarter

obligation: Annual tenant income certifications on file
due_rule_text_verbatim: upon initial occupancy and annually thereafter
